name: Velocity: Cyberspace Warfare for Space Industry Engagement Day
objective: Want to work on real cybersecurity challenges for U.S. space systems? SpaceWERX and the 6th Sustainment Squadron are bringing together government and industry on July 14 in El Segundo, California for Velocity: Cyberspace Warfare for Space Industry Engagement Day . The event runs 1 – 6 p.m. PT and includes keynote briefings, a live Q&A panel, technical breakouts, and networking with the teams making acquisition decisions. There are also SBIR/STTR funding opportunities tied to this release. Spots are limited; register today!
